clusters.title: Spot Price / Reserve Manipulation via Flash Loan
clusters.impact_summary: Undercollateralized borrowing or artificial liquidations via instantaneous AMM skew.
clusters.remediation: Integrate decentralized Chainlink Price Feeds or multi-block geometric TWAP oracles.
clusters.poc_code:
// Flash Loan Attack Flow:
1. Borrow large liquidity (e.g. 10,000 WETH from Aave/Balancer)
2. Dump WETH into Uniswap V2 pair -> artificially depress token price
3. Call target.liquidate() or target.borrow() at distorted spot rate
4. Repay Flash loan and keep extracted surplus

clusters.title: ERC-4626 First Depositor Vault Share Inflation via Direct Donation
clusters.impact_summary: First depositor frontrunning and dilution of subsequent user deposits.
clusters.remediation: Mint virtual dead shares (virtual assets offset) to prevent zero-share rounding.
clusters.poc_code:
// Inflation Attack Flow:
1. Attacker deposits 1 wei -> receives 1 share
2. Attacker transfers 100 ETH directly to vault contract
3. 1 share is now backed by 100 ETH + 1 wei
4. Victim deposits 50 ETH -> receives 0 shares due to rounding down!
